item.title: Trump calls GDP figures 'fake' and demands an investigation of Commerce Department
item.description: President Donald Trump is suggesting without evidence a conspiracy within the government to report upwardly revised economic growth figures after the midterm elections that were disastrous for Republicans.

item.title: Leaders choose Spain's former central bank head as next European Central Bank president
item.description: Eurozone leaders have chosen a new president of the European Central Bank. It's Pablo Hernandez de Cos, the former head of Spain's central bank.

item.title: Zelenskyy warns of imminent major Russian attack on Ukraine’s power grid
item.description: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy says Russia is preparing a major attack on Ukraine’s energy infrastructure as crews race to repair damage from earlier strikes.

item.title: French actor Gérard Depardieu to stand trial on rape charge, lawyer says
item.description: A lawyer representing French actor Gérard Depardieu says he has been ordered to stand trial on a charge of raping a young actress at his Paris home in 2018.

item.title: Emirati curator Hoor Al Qasimi becomes first Arab woman to lead Venice Biennale art show
item.description: Hoor Al Qasimi has been named as the first Arab and seventh woman to lead the Venice Biennale contemporary art exhibition, set for 2028.
